findings: Successfully forwarded protocol counters add actual pipe-write/socket-send return values in both directions. Bounded launcher command-header bytes are excluded. Echo control independently checks exact bytes.
OwnedGroup retains the leader via waitid(WNOWAIT), signals the group before wait4 reaps that leader, and avoids Popen polling that would release its PID reservation early.

Darwin EPERM handling accepts only recognized empty output or exactly the retained owned-leader zombie from bounded ps -g probes; unexpected/ambiguous/living/extra persisted members fail qualification.

Proxy try/finally cancels and wait4-reaps its native child before returning fault receipts for pump exceptions, deadline and cooperative cancellation. Abrupt supervisor exit has group-cleanup/native-PID-absence evidence only, never native-owner wait4 proof or an accepted benchmark row.
Both client and supervisor captures continuously drain with bounded retained memory. First/second captured-reader creation controls confirm child ownership settlement on construction failures.

The materializer byte count is successful returned Unix.write_substring bytes after lseek. Calls count attempts, including EINTR retries; fields no longer imply pwrite syscalls or attempted-byte counts.

Ordinary/receiver-clone/source-clone logical output quantities remain declared models. Wrong, mixed and preserved-only algorithm traces are rejected. Physical write, allocation and sharing amounts are not measured.

Fixture controls independently prove unchanged complement and exact expected source bytes. Actual selected snapshot source/package manifests identify binary source artifacts rather than changing repository HEAD.
limitations: Finite qualification is not throughput, 18-versus-36 worker selection, OxCaml-specific speedup, representative photograph or Adobe validation evidence.
Worker budgets are independently configured per same-host endpoint, allowing two budgets rather than enforcing a machine-wide cap.
wait4 CPU may include reaped descendants; maximum RSS is not aggregate process-tree peak RSS or a memory cap. Block operations are not physical storage byte counts.
Python socket/pipe bridge overhead and warm/uncontrolled host activity remain part of this experiment; there is no encrypted/real-network, cold-cache, cross-volume or non-APFS qualification.
No Adobe, Lightroom, preview renderer, Photo payload/catalog/cache or Photo-volume operations were performed by this independent audit. Only small synthetic controls ran.
resolved_findings: Native child was formerly unguarded on supervisor output-pump failure; proxy finally now settles and wait4-reaps it.
Previously terminal supervisors bypassed parent group cleanup; WNOWAIT reservation now preserves ownership through kill-before-leader-reap.
Captured-reader creation formerly preceded the ownership guard; both reader construction failures now settle the spawned client.
Byte fields previously said attempted pwrite bytes; fields now report successful returned write bytes and attempts, matching lseek/write production code.
Semantic/source-clone/ordinary selectors formerly admitted some incompatible traces; strict mixed and preserved-only controls now reject them.
status: accepted: final source, independently rerun small controls and terminal 13-row native CLI receipt
